realeyes.radioactive-decay: Look for a transformation of the observed mass that makes elapsed time act linearly.
realeyes.usaaio-rank-one: Apply the map to each standard basis vector. Which resulting columns already lie on the same line?
realeyes.kaif-the-conqueror: Imagine every starting cell joining the same initial frontier. Which distance defines the day each new cell first changes?
realeyes.simple-objects: Can you count separate outlines without recognizing their shape? Test what happens when a border has a small gap.
realeyes.neural-playground: Separate what the network can represent from whether training finds it. Hold all but one setting fixed when testing your diagnosis.
realeyes.deceptive-points: If you fit on a few small subsets, which candidate relationship gets broad agreement on points it never saw?
realeyes.face-matching: The number of matches varies per person. Compare each reference’s similarity gaps before deciding how many results to return.
realeyes.lost-interpreter: Group tiny programs that differ by just one instruction or operand. Look for changes in execution order as well as arithmetic.
realeyes.hidden-digits: Take one actual cluster and inspect unclear images by eye. Which differences reflect the written digit, and which are just shifts or stroke styles?
realeyes.color-quantization: After the k-means baseline, print the weighted cost terms separately. Which can you reduce while causing only a small increase in reconstruction error?
realeyes.anpc-river-crossing: A state needs the boat’s location as well as the distribution of the pairs. Two states that differ only by permuting pair names may describe the same problem.
realeyes.dieting-network: Trace one input through the frozen linear layers. What information is shared by multiple neurons before each activation?
realeyes.dropped-tarots: Start with one flat group of points. A local 2D coordinate system can render it, but the resulting image may still need a rotation or flip.
realeyes.different-collection: What changes from one photo session to the next even when the main object looks similar? Compare background, color and lighting cues.
realeyes.noise-in-data-labels: The two models can disagree on which examples are difficult. What happens if a model uses the other model’s ranking? Check this separately for each class.
realeyes.ecg-four-features: With four slots, look for cues that capture different parts of the signal, such as timing and shape. Check which cues still help after the most confusable classes are isolated.
realeyes.whisper-or-scream: After matching volume, compare voicing and how energy spreads across frequencies. Look for a cue you can verify across several different speakers or words.
realeyes.unet: Track every spatial shape through the unpadded convolutions. For the metric, test a case where a mostly empty mask makes pixel accuracy look deceptively good.
realeyes.pendulum: Ask which equation coefficients are identifiable on each observed side of the gap. Fit or check them separately before solving for the switch inside the gap.
